plugins.name: claude-code-internals
plugins.description: Gives Claude source-level knowledge of its own architecture, read out of the shipping binaries rather than the docs — including the parts the docs get wrong. 179 lessons across 49 chapters: hooks, the permission pipeline, settings precedence, skills and plugins, sub-agents, MCP, memory, compaction, sessions, and OAuth. A third of it is Claude Cowork's runtime — host-loop vs VM-loop, sandbox mounts, path resolution, file delivery, and the stream-json control protocol — which is documented almost nowhere else. Ships with keyword + semantic search over every lesson.
